description: Fetch the most recently published XKCD comic. Returns comic number, title, image URL, alt/hover text, publication date, transcript (if available), and permalink.
name: get_latest

alt.description: Alt text for the comic image

link.description: URL link related to the comic, or null if not present

safe_title.description: The comic title with special characters escaped

transcript.description: Transcript of the comic, or null if not available

url.description: URL to view the comic on xkcd.com

title: Get Latest
